title: Golzentipp Adventure Mountain Obertilliach
name: Golzentipp Adventure Mountain Obertilliach
kurzbeschreibung: Golzentipp at 2,317 m in Obertilliach: East Tyrol's most scenic family adventure mountain featuring a 10-seater gondola, Jufenkamm ridge, and Dolomites views.
beschreibung:
Overview

The prominent Erlebnisberg Golzentipp perches at an elevation of 2,317 meters as a gently rolling panoramic summit in the Gailtaler Alpen high above the heritage-listed clustered village of Obertilliach in the East Tyrolean Lesachtal (Lienz district). Aboard the modern 10-passenger gondola Golzentippbahn, mountain enthusiasts and families glide up in just a few minutes from around 1,400 meters to the high plateau of the Connyalm at 2,050 meters. As a sunny panoramic balcony, Golzentipp opens up an awe-inspiring 360-degree panorama taking in the rugged crags of the Carnic Alps, the Lienzer Dolomiten, and the glaciated peaks of the Hohe Tauern.

Panoramic Hiking & Jufenkamm

The hiking area around Golzentipp is distinguished by vast, gentle alpine pastures and family-friendly walking trails. From the mountain station at Connyalm, a wide and leisurely trail leads in around 45 minutes of walking up to the prominent summit cross of Golzentipp. Along the way, hikers pass the picturesque reservoir pond with relaxation loungers and water play stations for children. For more ambitious mountain hikers, Golzentipp serves as an ideal gateway to the scenic ridge trail across the Jufenkamm or onward to Grippalm. Plant lovers appreciate the extraordinary botanical variety: in early summer, the slopes glow in deep crimson with countless alpine roses, gentians, and arnica flowers.

Visit & Getting There

The Golzentippbahn operates daily during the summer season from mid-June to early October from 09:00 to 16:30 (during the winter months it serves as a traditional family ski resort). Cable car fares (as of the 2025/2026 season): round trip adults approx. €24.00, seniors approx. €21.50, children and youth (6 to 15 years) approx. €13.00, young children free. Holders of the regional Glockner-Dolomiten Card receive discounts. Getting there by car: Via the B100 (Drautalstraße) to Tassenbach, branching off onto the B111 (Gailtalstraße) and continuing for about 15 kilometers to Obertilliach (large free parking lot directly at the valley station of the gondola). By public transport: ÖBB train to Sillian or Tassenbach station, where regional valley buses connect to Obertilliach.

Tips

The mountain station and the sun terrace of the Panoramarestaurant Connyalm are accessible with minimal barriers; the summit path follows a well-maintained mountain trail and requires sturdy hiking footwear. Sample traditional East Tyrolean Schlipfkrapfen at the Connyalm while soaking in the breathtaking view across the pristine Tyrolean Gailtal.
